# Adrian Treleaven

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v3 c11 P1](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0001), [v4 c6 P8](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0008)</sub>
- **Origin:** Ontario, Canada  <sub>[v2 c22 P12](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0012)</sub>
- **Role:** Journalist and author  <sub>[v4 c24 P15](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0015), [v4 c25 P4](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Adrian is a tall, broad-shouldered man with a handsome, intelligent face, wavy or thick brown hair, and large, dark-gray eyes. He has a warm, candid smile that reveals white teeth, though his expression often seems somber or lost in thought when at rest.

_Sources: [v3 c11 P1](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0001), [v3 c11 P12](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0012), [v4 c6 P8](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0008), [v4 c23 P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008), [v4 c23 P10](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0010)_

## Personality

Adrian is an imaginative, passionate, and sensitive writer who becomes deeply absorbed in his creative work. He possesses a charming, candid, and friendly demeanor that allows him to easily connect with like-minded people. Though he is an honorable man who respects boundaries and obligations, he experiences intense and romantic emotions.

_Sources: [v3 c11 P1](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0001), [v4 c4 P15](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0015), [v4 c23 P10](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0010), [v4 c24 P15](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0015), [v4 c26 P2](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0002), [v4 c26 P5](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0005)_

## History

Adrian Treleaven works as a journalist in Toronto. After recovering from typhoid fever, he travels to Seven Gulls Harbor on St. Brendan's Island to recuperate and visit his grandparents' historic cottage. During his stay, he boards with Lorna Vane, with whom he falls deeply in love, though he keeps his feelings secret out of respect for her situation with her incapacitated husband. Inspired by the area, Adrian collaborates with Captain Saul Garrick to adapt the captain's life log into a novel titled 'The Life-Book of Captain Saul'. Before departing at the end of the summer, Adrian confides his love for Lorna to Nell Harcourt, believing he must leave her forever. However, after it is discovered that Lorna's husband had actually died years prior and the man she cared for was his cousin, Adrian returns to Seven Gulls. He and Lorna declare their love and become engaged, planning to purchase the house of dreams as a summer home.

_Sources: [v4 c5 P13](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0013), [v4 c5 P17](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0017), [v4 c23 P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008), [v4 c24 P15](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0015), [v4 c25 P4](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0004), [v4 c26 P2](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0002), [v4 c26 P11](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0011), [v4 c31 P15](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0015), [v4 c36 P16](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0016), [v4 c38 P8](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0008), [v4 c38 P10](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0010)_

## Background by volume

- Grandson of John Tremayne and Damaris Leigh, the original occupants of the house of dreams at Seven Gulls  <sub>[v4 c22 P13](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0013), [v4 c23 P11](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0011), [v4 c24 P24](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0024)</sub>
- Son of Alice Tremayne  <sub>[v4 c24 P22](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0022), [v4 c24 P24](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0024)</sub>
- Nephew of Aunt Euphemia  <sub>[v1 c26 P13](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0013)</sub>
- Recovered from a severe bout of typhoid fever prior to visiting Seven Gulls  <sub>[v4 c5 P17](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0017)</sub>
